description: Data on freight movement through Kerala check posts in India is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors KIRAN B. This data pertains to the to and fro movement of goods vehicles through check posts of Kerala state in India. This data can be used to study the importance of freight management and economic aspects of goods industry. Coverage: national (IN); the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
